# Clean code and scope (always loaded)

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_agent_rules.py from rules.yml; do not edit by hand. Implements AGT-010, AGT-011. Only rules that no CI job or linter enforces. -->

- Comments MUST explain why (a constraint, a business rule source, a non-obvious trade-off), never what the next line does; a comment that restates code MUST be deleted and the code renamed if it was unclear (CLN-027).
- Comments MUST NOT contain narration of the edit (`# added`, `# now handles X`, `# fixed`), author or date stamps, ticket history, emoji, banners, or statements that the code was AI-generated; history belongs in version control (CLN-028).
- Public functions and classes SHOULD have a one-line docstring stating purpose and non-obvious behavior (units, side effects, raised errors); docstrings MUST NOT repeat parameter types that the annotations already give (CLN-030).
- Lint, type and complexity configuration (`[tool.ruff*]`, `[tool.mypy]`) MUST NOT be loosened to make code pass; changes require human approval via `CODEOWNERS`, and agents MUST NOT edit them for that purpose (CLN-032).
- A per-file ignore or `noqa` for a rule in the limits table MUST have a waiver reference (21-exceptions-and-waivers.md) (CLN-033).
- An agent MUST NOT disable, bypass or skip checks: no `--no-verify`, no removing or reordering CI jobs, no `allow_failure: true`, no new `# noqa`, `# type: ignore` or per-file lint ignores to get green (CLN-032) (PRC-023).
- Imports, function names and library calls MUST exist in the pinned dependency versions; unresolved or invented APIs are failures of `mypy` or tests and MUST NOT be "fixed" by adding `# type: ignore` or `Any` (20-dependencies-and-licensing.md covers hallucinated packages) (CLN-037).
- The diff MUST be limited to the task: no drive-by reformatting, renames, new files or dependencies unrelated to the request (CLN-038).
- Modules SHOULD stay under about 400 lines and classes SHOULD have a single responsibility; a file named `utils`, `helpers`, `misc` or `common_stuff` MUST NOT hold business logic (03-architecture.md limits `common/`) (CLN-007).
